title: Give the user the manufacturer's own published load data, cited
blocked_reason: Owner decision on load-data licensing (FIX-BACKLOG item 10). Berger and Hornady publish load data but their tables are not freely redistributable; some require purchase or subscription. The LOOKUP design is safe to specify, but what we may store, cache or republish is a commercial and legal decision.
prohibits: Do NOT compute, interpolate, extrapolate, average or fit any charge weight, powder constant or burn rate. This task produces a specification for a LOOKUP and a citation. The owner's instruction is explicit: give the user what the manufacturer published, not our own calculated load.

Do not store or republish a manufacturer's tables without establishing the licence position for that specific source. Linking to a public page and copying its contents into our seed data are different acts with different permissions.
Do not treat this as fully unblocked. It is blocked on the licensing decisions listed above, recorded in FIX-BACKLOG.md item 10.
Do not present a sourced figure and a derived one in the same visual treatment. That is the single failure this design exists to prevent.
